desc:
🌟 Welcome to Pony Land! Create, Customize, and Explore! 🌟

Inspired by My Little Pony animated series, a game where you can design your very own pony. Whether you want a majestic Unicorn, a speedy Pegasus, or a strong Earth pony, the choice is yours!

✨ FEATURES:
🔹 Deep Customization: Choose from hundreds of body parts, eyes, manes, and tails!
🔹 Unique Patterns: Mix and match stunning colors and custom coat patterns.
🔹 Accessories & Hats: Collect items from the world and adjust them perfectly on your pony.
🔹 Dynamic Animations: Switch between different idle, wing, and tail styles.
🔹 Save Slots: Want more than one pony? Save up to 3 different skins for every species!

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:

Click Play!

Open your Inventory to customize your pony.

Explore the world to gather resources and craft rare items
